quests.instruction: Which shape has exactly 3 straight sides?
quests.hint: Count the sides on each shape — one of them has the fewest of all.
quests.explanation: A triangle always has exactly 3 straight sides and 3 corners.
quests.funFact: Three is the smallest number of straight sides any closed shape can have.

quests.instruction: Which shape has no straight sides and no corners at all?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that curves smoothly all the way around.
quests.explanation: A circle is one smooth curve with no straight sides and no corners anywhere.
quests.funFact: Because a circle has no corners, it can spin in place forever without catching on anything.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 sides that are all exactly the same length?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where every single side matches the others.
quests.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 matching corners.
quests.funFact: Because all its sides match, a square looks the same from every side.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 sides, but two are longer than the other two?
quests.hint: Look for the shape shaped a bit like a stretched square.
quests.explanation: A rectangle has 4 sides, with two long sides and two short sides.
quests.funFact: A rectangle's opposite sides always match each other in length.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 3 corners and 3 straight sides?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with the fewest corners of the three.
quests.explanation: A triangle has exactly 3 corners, one at the end of each straight side.
quests.funFact: No matter how a triangle is stretched or squeezed, it always keeps 3 corners.

quests.instruction: Which shape curves smoothly all around but is longer than it is wide?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that looks like a circle that has been gently stretched.
quests.explanation: An oval curves smoothly all around, with no corners, but is longer on one side.
quests.funFact: An oval has no straight sides at all, just like a circle.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 corners and 4 sides that are all equal in length?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where you could measure any side and get the same number.
quests.explanation: Every side of a square is the exact same length, and it has 4 corners.
quests.funFact: A square is a special rectangle where all four sides just happen to match.

quests.instruction: Which shape has zero corners anywhere on its edge?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with a completely smooth, unbroken edge.
quests.explanation: A circle's edge is one smooth curve, so it has zero corners.
quests.funFact: Circles are the only common shape with no straight parts anywhere on their edge.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 sides and stands on a single pointed corner?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that looks like a square tipped up to balance on one tip.
quests.explanation: A diamond has 4 equal sides, just like a square, but it stands on one of its points.
quests.funFact: Turning a square so it balances on a corner is exactly how you get a diamond.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 corners that are all perfect right angles, but not all sides equal?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with square corners but sides of two different lengths.
quests.explanation: A rectangle has 4 right-angle corners, but its sides come in two different lengths.
quests.funFact: Rectangles and squares both have square corners, but only squares have equal sides.

quests.instruction: Which shape has the fewest sides of all closed shapes?
quests.hint: Look for the shape you could not remove even one more side from.
quests.explanation: A triangle has only 3 sides, the fewest of any closed shape.
quests.funFact: If you tried to build a closed shape with only 2 straight sides, it wouldn't close up.

quests.instruction: Which shape has a smooth curved edge but is not perfectly round?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that is round but longer in one direction.
quests.explanation: An oval curves smoothly like a circle, but it is longer in one direction, not perfectly round.
quests.funFact: You can spot an oval because it looks squeezed a little compared to a circle.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners that each form a perfect right angle?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where every corner looks like the corner of a book page.
quests.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides, and every corner forms a perfect right angle.
quests.funFact: A right angle is the same square corner you see where two walls meet.

quests.instruction: Which shape could you trace forever and never reach a corner?
quests.hint: Look for the shape whose edge never turns sharply, only curves.
quests.explanation: Tracing a circle's edge, you would curve smoothly forever and never hit a corner.
quests.funFact: A circle's edge is called its circumference, and it has no straight parts at all.

quests.instruction: Which shape has two short sides and two long sides, with 4 square corners?
quests.hint: Look for the shape shaped like a stretched-out square.
quests.explanation: A rectangle has two short sides, two long sides, and 4 square corners.
quests.funFact: Doors and books are usually rectangles because that shape is easy to fit through frames.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 equal sides, but its corners point up, down, left, and right instead of like a box?
quests.hint: Picture a square, then tilt it so one corner points to the floor.
quests.explanation: A diamond has 4 equal sides like a square, just turned so its corners point in four directions.
quests.funFact: A diamond and a square have the same number of equal sides, just a different tilt.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 3 sides that meet to form 3 sharp corners?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with the fewest points of all.
quests.explanation: A triangle's 3 sides meet at 3 sharp corners.
quests.funFact: A triangle is one of the strongest shapes used in bridges and towers.

quests.instruction: Which shape has no corners but is clearly longer than it is wide?
quests.hint: Look for the shape shaped like an egg, with a smooth curve all around.
quests.explanation: An oval has no corners at all, and it is longer than it is wide.
quests.funFact: Eggs, footballs, and race tracks are all shaped like ovals.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 sides where opposite sides AND neighboring sides are all equal?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where no matter which side you pick, it's the same length.
quests.explanation: In a square, every side is equal, whether it's across from or next to another side.
quests.funFact: This is what makes a square more special than a regular rectangle.

quests.instruction: Which shape has opposite sides equal, but neighboring sides are different lengths?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where the top matches the bottom, but the sides are shorter.
quests.explanation: A rectangle's opposite sides match, but its neighboring sides are different lengths.
quests.funFact: A rectangle's top and bottom are always equal, and so are its left and right sides.

quests.instruction: Which shape has an edge that is the exact same distance from the center at every point?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where the middle is always exactly as far from the edge.
quests.explanation: Every point on a circle's edge is the exact same distance from its center.
quests.funFact: This special distance is called the radius of the circle.

quests.instruction: Which shape is the only one here with just 3 corners?
quests.hint: Count the corners on each shape carefully.
quests.explanation: A triangle has only 3 corners, fewer than a square or rectangle.
quests.funFact: Musical triangle instruments are named after this very shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 equal sides and looks like it is balancing on a single tip?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that seems to be standing on one pointed corner.
quests.explanation: A diamond has 4 equal sides and appears to balance on a single bottom point.
quests.funFact: Kites are often shaped like diamonds because it helps them catch the wind.

quests.instruction: Which shape has a smooth, rounded edge but is not equally round on every side?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that curves like a circle, but looks a bit squeezed.
quests.explanation: An oval curves smoothly like a circle, but is longer in one direction than the other.
quests.funFact: If you squeeze a circle gently from two sides, you get an oval shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape would look exactly the same if you turned it a quarter turn?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that is perfectly balanced on every side.
quests.explanation: Turning a square a quarter turn makes it look exactly the same as before.
quests.funFact: This kind of matching is called symmetry, and a square has a lot of it.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 right-angle corners but would look different after a quarter turn?
quests.hint: Look for the shape where the long sides and short sides would switch places.
quests.explanation: Turning a rectangle a quarter turn changes it from wide to tall, so it looks different.
quests.funFact: A rectangle's long and short sides are what make it look different when turned.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 3 sides that could each be a different length?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with the smallest number of sides that can all vary.
quests.explanation: A triangle has 3 sides, and unlike a square, they don't all have to match.
quests.funFact: Triangles come in many types, some with all equal sides and some with none equal.

quests.instruction: Which shape has an edge with no beginning and no end?
quests.hint: Look for the shape you could trace around forever without stopping at a corner.
quests.explanation: A circle's edge loops around smoothly with no beginning or end.
quests.funFact: This is why circles are often used to represent things that go on and on.

quests.instruction: Which shape has 4 equal sides arranged so its widest point is in the middle?
quests.hint: Look for the shape that bulges out in the middle and comes to points top and bottom.
quests.explanation: A diamond's widest point is right in the middle, between its top and bottom corners.
quests.funFact: This wide-middle shape is why diamond patterns look so eye-catching on clothing.

quests.instruction: Which shape has the same number of sides as corners, with every side matching?
quests.hint: Look for the shape with 4 sides and 4 corners, all perfectly even.
quests.explanation: A square has 4 sides and 4 corners, and every side is exactly equal.
quests.funFact: Having equal sides makes a square a very balanced and steady shape.
